name: MYB proto-oncogene, transcription factor

function.text: MYB encodes transcriptional activator Myb. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Basal cell carcinoma of prostate; Adenoid cystic carcinoma of breast; Pulmonary adenoid cystic carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports rearrangement context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
